headline: TEX @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.63 at TOR 4.22, with a projected total of 8.85. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved +0.48 runs while TOR moved +0.06, changing the projected margin by +0.43 runs. The projected total climbed +0.54, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Patrick Corbin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Wyatt Langford, Jake Burger, Brandon Nimmo, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Justin Foscue, Davis Schneider because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
